html:
Agents!
 
Be prepared for our new major update with new Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. members and other new features!

5 New Heroes from Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.!
New Chapters and the improved Story Missons!
Max Level raised to 60!
Who is the baddest alliance? All New Alliance Battle Mode!
4 more 6 Star Skills and much more!
 
Check out the details below!
 
▣ 5 New Heroes
 
5 New Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. heroes have been added.
 

 
Along with new Heroes, new team bonuses & new max level achievement has been added.
 
▣ Mission Improvement & New Stories
 
1. Normal & Elite Missions Merged into Story missions
Normal Missions and Elite Missions are now merged into more streamlined Story Missions.
 

 
There is no entry limit to Story Missions, while there is daily limit on Biometrics amount gained..
 

 
※Earn one piece Biometrics in the mission, and your daily limit will reduce by 1. Once your daily limit hits 0, you may no longer earn any more Biometrics from the stage until the daily limit is refreshed.
If you earn a multiple number of Biometrics within a stage, the daily limit count will only reduce by 1.
 
 
2. New Story Missions & Chapters
 
The story extends with Chapter 9 and 10.
Witness how Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. join the ranks of our heroes and fight alongside with them in the new chapters!
 - Chapter 9 (Stage 1~8)
 - Chapter 10 (Stage 1~8)

- Save our universe against the more powerful Super Villains threatening our peace!
 
▣ Level Cap Expansion
 
1. Maximum Level Cap for Heroes and S.H. from 50 to 60!
 
Train your heroes up to Level 60 to deal with new chapters and stronger foes!
 

- ★6 Heroes can be progressed up to Level 60!
 
2. Gear Upgrade to +20
 
Hero max level is accompanied by gear upgrade limit up to +20.
 
Starting from +16, antimatter is consumed for higher gear upgrade.
Gear Upgrade results will be broken into Rank up, Super Rank Up and Ultra Rank Up, each filling different amount of your rank up point. Reach 100% of your rank up point to pass gain +1.
 

Don’t forget to stop by Antimatter Generator to harvest enough amount for your gear upgrade!
<>
 

- If it is your lucky day, you may even get an Ultra Rank Up!
 
 
▣ New Feature: Alliance Battle
 
Compete your score against other alliances in Alliance Battle!
 
Alliance Battle requires certain type, gender, or other requirements to join!
Entry requirement refreshes every day.
 
 

Join Alliance Battle in “Alliance” or “Arena” Menu!
 
To join Alliance Battle, make up a team of 3 characters that meet the requirement of each day.
Don’t forget that there is a daily limit to the entry.
 
Defeat your foes one swarm after another, and you will earn certain amount of points.
You will be facing stronger enemies as you continue your fight.
 

Longer survival in the arena grants you greater rewards!
 
Alliance Ranking will be determined by the total score of each alliance member acquired.
Rewards will be sent out every Friday 1:00 (UTC+0)
※ You may not receive the rewards if you joined your Alliance after the weekly ranking is refreshed.

Note. The images are taken from a test version and may not represent the actual game play.
ø You can get 'She-Hulk', 'Sister-Grimm' and 'Singularity' from Biometric Selector from Alliance battle!
 
▣ New 6★ Skills for 4 More Heroes
 
More 6★ Skill are newly added to the following heroes.
 
 - Sister Grimm: Rock and Roll
 - Singularity: Dimensional Tear
 - She-Hulk: Exhibit A
 - Luke Cage: Tactical Offence

Note. The name of Singularity’s 5★ Skill is changed from “Dimensional Tear” to “Meteorite.”

 
 
▣ 3 New Uniforms
 
Meet our Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. exclusive uniforms for Mocking Bird, Daisy Johnson, and Deathlok
 

- Check out the new uniforms in the Uniform or Marvel Universe menu.
 
▣ Other Improvements
 
1. Resolved the issue with skill upgrade values of certain skills not being applied
2. Damage of Sweet Christmas skill for Luke Cage is improved.
3. Battle World
 - Now you can enter thorough Arena menu.
 - Daily limit is applied for entries for all ongoing Battle Worlds combined.
 - Participation Reward is given based on number of joins, instead of wins.
4. Resolved the issue with some projectiles not hitting enemies correctly.
 -Yondu: Ravager Strike
 -Singularity: Space Fold
 -Loki: Arcane Blast (Illusions' Arcane Blast included)
5. New function is added that allows you to start a new Multi Play session with the same team members from your previous session.
6. Re-use Button for Clear ticket is newly added.
7. You can expand your inventory capacity up to 500 by using Crystals.
8. 4 New Premium Covers newly added: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
9. Passive Skill cooldown time is properly applied in Skill Preview.
10. Skill damages involving summoned illusions of heroes now reflect heroes' and skill level.
 : Sister Grimm (Now You See Me…), Loki (Mind Games), Kingpin (Criminal Mastermind)
11. Heroes with ranged normal attack now use their close normal attack only when enemies are near your hero
 : Singularity, Sister Grimm, Iron Man
12. Resolved the issue with Winter Soldier freezing after being hit by enemies.
13. Resolved the issue with Venom's Symbiote Surge skill not breaking guard.
14. Some parts of tutorial are simplified.
15. Resolved the issue with striker characters using certain unintended skills
 : Ant Man (Flying Rush), Yellow Jacket (Flying Barrage), Wasp (Target Rush)
16. War-Machine's Missile Strafe skill will not shoot any rockets if there is no enemy
17. Experience points gained as the stage clear rewards is increased.
18. Amount of time needed to activate Best Condition is reduced
19. Leader Skills are no longer applied in Skill Preview.
20. Due to Normal and Elite Missions being merged, certain achievement rewards are now improved.
